R.name: Realistic
R.description: You like working with your hands, tools, and machines. You enjoy building, fixing, and being outdoors. You're practical, physical, and like seeing real results from your work.
R.kidDescription: You love building things, working with your hands, and being outside!

I.name: Investigative
I.description: You love analyzing, researching, and solving complex problems. You're curious about how things work and enjoy diving deep into science, data, and ideas.
I.kidDescription: You love figuring out how things work and solving puzzles!

A.name: Artistic
A.description: You're creative and expressive. You love design, writing, music, or visual arts. You value originality and want your work to inspire, entertain, or communicate something meaningful.
A.kidDescription: You love making things, being creative, and expressing yourself!

S.name: Social
S.description: You care deeply about people and love teaching, helping, and making a difference. You're empathetic, a good communicator, and energized by teamwork and connection.
S.kidDescription: You love helping people, teaching, and being part of a team!

E.name: Enterprising
E.description: You're a natural leader who loves persuading, selling, and starting new things. You enjoy taking risks, making deals, and turning ideas into reality.
E.kidDescription: You love leading, starting projects, and convincing people!

C.name: Conventional
C.description: You're detail-oriented, organized, and love working with data and systems. You thrive with structure and find satisfaction in accuracy, planning, and keeping things running smoothly.
C.kidDescription: You love organizing, planning, and making sure everything is in order!
